name: codex-memory
description: Local-first memory engine plugin with a first-party Codex adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first memory and context compaction for Codex
interface.longDescription: Codex Memory is a local-first memory engine for Codex that captures durable context, compresses session knowledge into reusable memory artifacts, and prepares budget-aware context packs without requiring a semantic backend by default.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current Codex Memory setup and explain which memory layers are active.
Help me understand how Codex Memory reduces prompt tokens without losing useful context.
